provenance.window_title: Why every design system eventually becomes a Figma file nobody opens | by Dan Mall | Medium

lines.text: Why every design system eventually becomes a Figma file nobody opens
Every design system starts as a promise: build once, use everywhere. Two years later it is
a library with 400 components and a Slack channel where people ask which button to use.
